name: mailsync
description: AI-powered Gmail importance notifier for Discord with a VPS-hosted MySQL backend.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mailsync/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dashboard,worker -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @mailsync/api" "npm run dev -w @mailsync/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @mailsync/worker"
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -n api,bot,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start -w @mailsync/api" "npm run start -w @mailsync/bot" "npm run start -w @mailsync/worker"
